items.title: Toots Thielemans — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: But later on, when I start to travel. But in school, in those days when you went to école moyenne, they called it. It takes twelve years. You have six years elementary and then six years secondary, right? And my direction was mathematics and languages. So at age… after twelve years of school, I could speak… We had good English teachers, good German. So the four languages were French, Flemish, English, and German. So when I was sixteen, I could write business letters in English and in German. And of course, by…
Could you talk about your parents? What were their jobs or occupations?
